# Awesome Monash Tools

> Agent-native MCP servers for Monash University. Ed, Moodle, Gmail and OnTrack, exposed as 22 read-only tools for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, DeepSeek Harness and any MCP host.

## What it is

- Four stdio MCP servers (`ed`, `moodle`, `gmail`, `ontrack`) plus one combined server (`all`).
- A CLI for authentication: `awesome-monash login <source>`, `status`, `serve`.
- Read-only by construction: no submit, no post, no send, no delete.
- Local-only: credentials in `~/.config/awesome-monash-tools/credentials.json` (0600), no server, no telemetry.

## Who it is for

AI agents answering questions about a Monash student's own account: deadlines, Ed discussions, tutor feedback on FIT tasks, and official email.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jackdsjk/awesome-monash-tools.git
cd awesome-monash-tools
npm install
npm run build
npm link
awesome-monash login ed
awesome-monash status
```

## MCP entry points

| Server | Command |
|---|---|
| All sources | `awesome-monash serve all` |
| Ed | `awesome-monash serve ed` |
| Moodle | `awesome-monash serve moodle` |
| Gmail | `awesome-monash serve gmail` |
| OnTrack | `awesome-monash serve ontrack` |

## Constraints

- Unofficial, not affiliated with Monash University.
- Node.js 20.11+; Google Chrome only for the two SSO logins.
- No write access, no remote service, no credential sharing.
